provenance: AI-assisted synthetic English support messages and labels authored for this project. No real customer records. Labels were assigned during authoring and have not been independently annotated.
split_policy: Fixed scenario-group split. All utterances in a group stay in the same split. Validation selects the confidence threshold only; test groups are held out from fitting and threshold selection. This small synthetic set is a demonstration, not evidence of production generalization.
